scale_factor_reason: 1x and 2x have identical game/lab CSS layouts, authoritative log, impact, recorded frames, replay ticks and advancing scrubber values. Game BrainView uses 1,008,000 pixels at 2x, within its unchanged 1,048,576-pixel budget. Lab activity respects its existing 32,768-pixel cap at both DPRs. Only raster resolution changes.

selection.rule: First neural seed in ascending integer order whose single swat escapes with a recorded neural takeoff onset strictly before impact. Walk 1500 ms, observe the current body position at tick 3000, aim there, fixed 600 ms hold. Environment seed 8128. Every tried seed is retained; no aesthetic selection.
selection.aim: Current body position at 1500 ms; no lead
selection.og_rule: Recorded hero replay frame with maximum observed spike count
selection.lab_media: Re-record new story at registered strength, step 1 then step 2.

sign.rule: First V2E T1a N-SIGN null in ascending seed order whose s* equals the family median; no other outcome enters selection.

strength.scope: Data-only export of an existing null. UI is unchanged; no new scientific trial.
strength.selection_rule: the T1a H0-STR N-STRENGTH null whose H0b equals the family median of the 499 values; ties go to the lowest index.

game-hero.gif.rule: 112-color global median-cut palette from every tenth downscaled full frame; reserve one 960x600 sample area for semantic green #63F29A and five tan body shades, as in V2M; no dithering.
game-hero.gif.lossless_delta_check: Every decoded RGB frame equals its palette-quantized source frame byte for byte. Transparent delta pixels retain unchanged previous-frame pixels.
